Subject: Renewal commit revalidation & churn triage — AlphaBiotech

Hi Lara,

Per our Q3 close cadence I want to lock the renewal commit for AlphaBiotech and capture any churn risk we should budget against. Attached is a short workbook (commit_recheck_q3.xlsx) with the proposed ARR lines, seat counts, and two churn flags we surfaced during CS health checks.

Asks:
- Can you confirm the three line items (Clinical Analytics, Research Seats, API Bulk) are still valid for the Oct 1 renewal?
- Confirm whether the Clinical Ops team plans to drop seats (we flagged potential churn there).
- If there are any PO or procurement timing constraints, please share now so we can align finance forecast.

Suggested timeline:
- Today: confirm line items and any high-risk seats
- By EOD Thu (Aug 5): sign-off or updated ARR numbers
- Aug 10: finance to lock committed ARR for the quarter-end report

I'll coordinate with Ben to set a quick 20–30m sync if you prefer to walk through the spreadsheet.

Thanks — I appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commit_recheck_q3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)
Attachment: alpha_contract_summary.pdf (pdf, 7 pages)

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

- Clinical Analytics, Research Seats, and API Bulk are the three active SKUs. Procurement has asked us to split the API Bulk line into two invoices this year, but total ARR stays the same.
- Clinical Ops is likely to reduce 10 seats (pilot shift). That's the one risk to watch — the team lead mentioned budget reallocation.
- Procurement expects final PO by Aug 9 but asked for a clean SOW and invoice cadence to avoid internal approvals slipping.

A short call would help — I'm available Thu Aug 5 10–11am PT or Fri Aug 6 9–11am PT. Either works for me.

-Lara
